correctness.rationale: Stable harmonic trapping together with positive Poisson joint position-and-heading resetting gives a regenerative stationary distribution and finite polynomial moments. Fourier moments F_(p,q,n)=E[X^pY^q exp(in theta)] satisfy a triangular stationary generator recursion, with base F_(0,0,n)=r/(r+d n²). Explicit recurrence yields EX, EY², EXY² and an exact positive-denominator factor C=2r P_(d,h)(r)/D. Independently verified that polynomial factorization symbolically; coefficients of P are negative at degree 0, strictly positive at degrees 2-4 and nonnegative at 5-6, while the linear sign is arbitrary, hence exactly one Descartes sign variation for every d>0,h>=0 and a unique simple positive zero. Substituting r_T=sqrt(1+d)-1 makes the h factor zero and Q_d(r_T)<0; evaluating at athermal root R0 proves r_T<R(d,h)<=R0 and thermal monotonicity. Dominant balance proves athermal sqrt(5d) and sqrt(3d) limiting scales.

Novelty is qualified and the generator moment recursion as a method is prior.
